Open whitespace, precise alignment, large projection-readable Chinese sans-serif type. Follow the sample palette, typography and visual clarity. Vary composition purposefully.",

[
  "Use only exact title and key_points text as visible slide copy. Background and speaker_focus are context only, never add their text to slide.",
